summary: Implemented the placeholder-substitution specification from inputs/render.md as render_clean.py, exposing render(p) where p = {"template": t, "context": ctx}. A compiled regex matches exactly '{{' + [a-z]+ + '}}'; each match is replaced with context[name], or the empty string when the name is absent from the context. Substitution uses a single left-to-right re.sub pass with a callable replacement, so inserted values are literal text that is never re-scanned for placeholders, and no other transformation is applied. The module is stdlib-only and has no import-time side effects.
